page: City page: B2B lead generation Kolkata (/b2b-lead-generation-kolkata)

items.question: Do you offer healthcare lead generation services in Kolkata?
items.answer: Yes, for B2B sellers. If you sell medical devices, diagnostics, healthcare software or pharma products, we run outreach to procurement heads at hospital groups, lab and operations heads at diagnostic chains, distributors and hospital administrators. We do not run patient lead generation for hospitals or clinics.

items.question: Do you generate patient leads for hospitals in Kolkata?
items.answer: No. Myntmore runs B2B lead generation: we help companies that sell to hospitals, diagnostic chains and pharma distributors reach procurement and clinical decision-makers. Patient acquisition for hospitals and clinics needs local search, ads and booking systems, which a healthcare marketing agency is better placed to run.

items.question: Do we need to be based in Kolkata to work with you?
items.answer: No. The entire engagement runs remotely from our office in BKC, Mumbai, so it doesn't matter where in West Bengal, or beyond, your team is based. Strategy calls, sequence approvals and weekly reporting all happen over video calls and a shared dashboard, the same way they do for every client.

items.question: Do you only work with Kolkata companies?
items.answer: No. We have clients in Kolkata, but we run outbound systems for B2B companies across India and internationally, 130+ B2B companies so far. Campaigns for your buyers use the same process everywhere, with the lists, copy and send timing adapted to the industries and markets you sell to.

items.question: How quickly can we expect meetings to start?
items.answer: Campaigns go live within 18 days of kickoff, and most clients see their first qualified conversations in weeks 3 to 4. The first two weeks go into ICP mapping, list building, sending domains with warm-up, and copy. Meeting volume usually becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8, once messaging is tuned on real replies.

items.question: What does pricing look like?
items.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract. We don't publish a price list; we share a quote after a free GTM audit call, once we know which channels you need.

items.question: Which Kolkata industries do you have the most experience with?
items.answer: The page is built for four groups: companies that supply hospitals, diagnostic chains and distributors; engineering, steel and trading houses; IT and ITES firms; and financial services. The system adapts to any B2B ICP, so if you sell to other businesses from Kolkata, it applies.

items.question: What channels do you actually use to generate leads?
items.answer: Primarily cold email and LinkedIn outreach aimed at business buyers in healthcare supply, manufacturing, trading and financial services, layered with account-based marketing for named target accounts, and AI-assisted list building and personalisation underneath all three. We pick the mix based on where your buyers actually spend their attention.

items.question: How is this different from hiring an in-house SDR?
items.answer: Hiring an in-house SDR in Kolkata means months of recruiting and ramp-up before they're fully productive, and even then, one person can only run so many sequences at once. A managed outbound system has multiple channels live within about three weeks, at a fraction of the fully loaded cost of a hire, and scales without you managing headcount.

items.question: What do you need from us to get started?
items.answer: A clear picture of your ICP (even a rough one works), access to a domain we can set up for outbound sending, and about an hour of your time for an onboarding call. We handle ICP refinement, list building, sequence writing, and day-to-day campaign management from there.
